prompt: What state is the home of the losing team of the World Series three years before "Old Shufflefoot" managed his team to victory?
answer: Illinois. “Old Shufflefoot” was Lou Boudreau, who managed the Cleveland Indians to the 1948 World Series title. Three years earlier, the losing team was the Chicago Cubs, whose home state is Illinois.
